# Clipify

> Clipify keeps Twitch streams alive and viewers engaged by automatically playing clips when a streamer is away. It also helps creators publish, organize, embed, and share their clips beyond the stream.

Clipify uses browser-source overlays, so streamers can add it to OBS Studio, Streamlabs, XSplit, or similar software without installing a plugin. Its central promise is: Let your clips talk, even when you cannot.

## Product reference

- [Complete Clipify reference](https://clipify.us/llms-full.txt): Detailed product behavior, feature availability, galleries, Creator Pages, membership, integrations, and terminology.
- [Pricing](https://clipify.us/pricing): Current Free and Pro features, live prices, billing options, promotions, and the optional self-hosted Runner.
- [Help Center](https://help.clipify.us): Setup instructions, guides, and support documentation.

## Core experiences

- [Clipify Galleries](https://clipify.us/gallery): Publish curated or automatically updated Twitch clip galleries on a website using Clipify Elements.
- [Community](https://clipify.us/community): Discover opted-in Clipify creators, including partners, live channels, and other community members.
- [Interactive demo](https://clipify.us/#demo): Preview Clipify playback in a simulated streaming setup.
- [Get started](https://clipify.us/login): Sign in with Twitch and create a browser-source overlay.
